result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: an untranslated localization key is shown as a section title instead of real content.

issues.description: The second restaurant section header displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the correct localized title (e.g., 'Popular near you') and ensure localization fallback is handled so keys are never shown to users.
